# Google ML Kit translation and language identification

Dependencies: com.google.mlkit:translate:17.0.3; com.google.mlkit:language-id:17.0.6.
Terms: https://developers.google.com/ml-kit/terms
Translation guidelines: https://developers.google.com/ml-kit/language/translation/translation-terms
Attribution: https://cloud.google.com/translate/attribution
Official unmodified attribution images: https://docs.cloud.google.com/static/translate/images/google-translate-attribution.zip

Translation models are downloaded to the app through the official SDK. Input text and translation output are processed on-device; model downloads, compatibility information and SDK metrics may use network access. The app discloses this in its language setup and help UI. Google Translate is used to power translation in the application.
